checks.name: source
checks.detail: TTS must use user-provided text; recordings must come from the user

checks.name: alignment
checks.detail: Need real segment timestamps. Supply --timestamps SRT/JSON or an available --transcriber; guessed sentence times are not accepted

checks.name: segments
checks.detail: 4 ordered text segments within the audio

checks.name: audio-hash
checks.detail: Narration file must match the audio used to derive the segment timeline

checks.name: target-duration
checks.detail: Target must be at most 1200 seconds and must not truncate narration

checks.name: mixed-voice
checks.detail: Prepared mix must use the checked narration path and audio hash, or explicitly contain no voice

checks.name: mixed-output
checks.detail: Final audio path/hash must match the current mix record; rebuild after changing any narration
